description: This Java class 'NotificationServices' provides services related to preparing and sending email notifications within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for processing templates with dynamic data, generating email bodies, setting base URLs, and sending emails via integration with other services.

classes.name: NotificationServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for preparing and sending email notifications, including template processing, URL building, and email dispatch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Generates email message body from a template if not provided, then sends the email using the sendMail service.

methods.name: prepareNotification
methods.description: Processes a specified template with dynamic data to generate the email message body.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines and sets the base URL in the context, either from configuration or by constructing it dynamically.
